profile.description: AgentX replay workload with configurable occupancy-based user capacity assumptions; not measured human DAU.
profile.assumptions: All numeric settings above are editable planning assumptions, not published AgentX human-usage measurements. Recorded delays and fan-out are already included in AgentX; no extra think time is added.

fixedSequenceProxy.description: Optional non-agentic one-outstanding-request proxy. Defaults are hypothetical, not derived from the coding corpus. Disabled to avoid presenting fixed-length tests as measured coding-session capacity.

selected.reviewReason: Same source run, engine image and router version. Small/large measured loads scale together. Sparse sweeps do not establish the maximum capacity of either size.
Same source run and engine image; aggregated baseline versus P/D deployment. Small setup was tested at few concurrency values. Treat the result as an observed operating-point comparison.
Same source run and engine image. Shares the small baseline with the preceding example, so these are related examples, not independent replications.
Small-side sweep crosses the latency limit above the selected point; larger-side maximum remains unproven. Engine and router versions differ across four days.
